visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long dark hair, wearing a bright yellow off-the-shoulder ballgown and long yellow gloves, runs excitedly toward the camera against a CGI ballroom background with red curtains and a chandelier. (2) A second character dressed in a blue and yellow prince's coat with a white cravat and prosthetic beast horns/beard chases her, displaying an exaggerated angry facial expression. (3) The beast character sits dejectedly behind a table featuring a single red rose under a glass dome, resting their chin on their hand with a sad, pouting expression. (4) A professional woman in a white blazer and short dark hair appears in a studio setting with red and white curtains, looking directly at the camera with a friendly smile while holding a small golden hair mask jar. (5) Close-up of various hair care tools and a jar of Dove hair treatment on a wooden table. (6) The expert applies the white cream-like product to the woman in the yellow gown's hair, demonstrating a smoothing motion. (7) Split-screen comparison shows the back of a head with frizzy, tangled hair labeled 'BEFORE' and smooth, shiny hair labeled 'AFTER'. (8) The two women stand together in the studio, smiling and posing with the product line, followed by a comedic scene of them dancing together.
